description: This file provides OAuth API functions for generating OAuth links and retrieving OAuth provider configurations within the TestLink project.

methods.name: oauth_link
methods.description: Generates an OAuth link based on the provided configuration, adjusting the redirect URI for HTTPS if necessary, and returning the appropriate OAuth provider URL.

methods.name: getOAuthProviderCfg
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth provider configuration from the stored settings based on the provider name.
